scope: Synthetic development fixture, not qualification of any real documentation corpus. Labels express the statements below, not claims about a deployed engine.

documents.text: Parallel inference serves independent requests concurrently. It does not distribute gradient updates or train model replicas.
Distributed training synchronizes gradients between workers to update model weights. This procedure does not configure concurrent inference requests.
Host-free DDR residency keeps intermediate buffers in device-accessible external memory without returning them to the host. It still incurs DDR traffic and is not on-chip residency.
On-chip residency retains intermediate values in core or memory-tile storage between operators, avoiding their external-memory round trips.
Successful compilation proves the compiler emitted an artifact. It does not prove that the artifact ran correctly on the device.
Device qualification runs a specific artifact against reference outputs on the intended hardware and records the runtime, inputs, errors and conditions.
To identify deployed code, inspect the running process executable, runtime root and resolved artifact hashes. Current source HEAD alone does not identify the deployed artifact.
The source checkout HEAD identifies a source revision. Editing source without rebuilding or deploying does not change the running executable.
A measured bottleneck requires timing the operation on the actual artifact under controlled conditions. The suspected cost of an operator is only a hypothesis until measured.
The next experiment will test whether memory transfer dominates. No timing data has been collected, so memory transfer is a hypothesis, not a measured bottleneck.
START_BD_ID chooses the starting buffer descriptor identifier. The error BAD_BUFFER_DESCRIPTOR means the descriptor is invalid; adjust the descriptor configuration rather than change query pooling.
The embedding pooling option selects how token hidden states become one vector. CLS and last-valid-token pooling select different positions and define different embedding spaces.
CURRENT PROCEDURE: validate the staged package, obtain approval, then activate it and retain rollback artifacts. This replaces the historical copy-and-restart procedure.
SUPERSEDED EXPERIMENT: copy a new executable over the live binary and restart immediately without staging validation. Do not use this historical procedure for current deployments.
The sample embedding API supports at most 512 tokens including the query instruction. It rejects longer inputs; it does not silently truncate and does not support 32K requests.
The model card advertises a 32K context. This advertised model capability does not establish the smaller sample runtime's effective request limit.
Параллельный инференс обслуживает независимые запросы одновременно. Он не синхронизирует градиенты и не обучает распределённые копии модели.
Распределённое обучение синхронизирует градиенты между рабочими процессами для обновления весов. Это не режим обслуживания независимых запросов.
Чтобы установить, какой артефакт работает сейчас, проверьте исполняемый файл живого процесса и хеши реально загруженных артефактов. Текущий HEAD исходников этого не доказывает.
Успешная компиляция означает, что получен артефакт. Она не подтверждает корректное исполнение на устройстве и не заменяет сравнение с эталоном.
Образец API отклоняет запросы длиннее 512 токенов, включая инструкцию. Автоматическое усечение и режим 32K не поддерживаются.
Резидентность на кристалле сохраняет промежуточные данные в локальной памяти вычислительных ядер или memory tile. В отличие от внешней DDR, это позволяет избежать обмена с внешней памятью.
